content.short: io.net is a decentralized DePIN on Solana that provides massive GPU compute power for AI and machine learning.
content.description: io.net is a revolutionary Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) on Solana, providing high-performance GPU compute power for AI applications. By aggregating idle GPU capacity from data centers and crypto miners, io.net creates a massive cloud that is more cost-effective than centralized providers. This decentralized approach ensures developers can access compute power for complex AI operations without high costs. Leveraging Solana for low-cost rewards, io.net ensures transparent interactions, powered by the $IO token for governance and utility payments.
